title: wish
subtitle: Wishes about now, the past, complaints, and ability

blocks.text: We use the verb **wish** to talk about situations which are not real, but which we would like to be real. We use **wish** with different tenses and modals depending on what we want to say.

rows.use: Wishes about now or generally · wish + past simple
rows.example: Carl **wishes he had** a telescope. I **wish I wasn't** scared of spiders.

rows.use: Wishes about the past · wish + past perfect simple
rows.example: Tracy **wishes she'd seen** that programme about the moon last night. I **wish they hadn't cut down** so many trees.

rows.use: To criticise other people, or to complain · wish + would + bare infinitive
rows.example: I **wish people would throw** their litter in the bin and not on the ground! I **wish you wouldn't smoke** in here.

rows.use: Wishes about ability and permission now or in the future · wish + could + bare infinitive
rows.example: I **wish I could travel** through time! David **wishes he could come** with us, but his parents won't let him.

blocks.intro: When we use **wish** + past simple, we can say **I/he/she/it was ...** or **I/he/she/it were ...** . **Were** is more formal than **was**.
items: I wish I **was** an astronaut. (more informal)
I wish I **were** an astronaut. (more formal)

blocks.intro: We can use the phrase **if only** in the same way as **wish**.

blocks.text: We don't use **would** for wishes about ourselves.

blocks.incorrect: I wish I **would live** on Mars.

blocks.text: We use **wish** for situations that aren't real. If there is a possibility that something will happen in the future, we don't use **wish**, but we can use **hope**.

exercises.title: A · Verb forms
exercises.instruction: Complete using the correct form of the verbs in brackets.

items.prompt: I wish I ___ a million euros! I'd buy lots of great things. (have)
I wish we ___ in a bigger house. This one is too small. (live)
Becca wishes she ___ old enough to drive a car. (be)
Do you wish you ___ more confident about the exam tomorrow? (feel)
I wish my computer ___ . I can't check my e-mail. (not / be / broken)
I wish I ___ chocolate so much! I eat three bars a day! (not / like)
Grant wishes he ___ so many mistakes all the time. (not / make)
Look what they're wearing! I bet they wish they ___ so silly! (not / look)

exercises.title: B · Word box
exercises.instruction: Complete using the correct form of the verbs in the box. You may have to use some negative forms.

items.prompt: I wish I ___ in the countryside. The city is so noisy!
Tracy has got curly hair but she often wishes she ___ straight hair.
I wish our teachers ___ us less homework every day, but there's nothing I can do about it.
I wish I ___ so scared, but I do!
Do you wish you ___ contact lenses or are you happy with glasses?
Jake's mum wishes he ___ so much money on clothes whenever he goes shopping.

exercises.title: C · Picture wishes
exercises.instruction: Look at the situations and complete the sentences.

items.prompt: Someone is looking at lottery results. I wish I ___ . (win)
A teenager is in trouble. I wish I ___ to my mother. (listen)
Friends are at a landmark without a camera. I wish we ___ a camera with us. (bring)
A student is stuck on a test. I wish I ___ a bit harder for this test. (study)
Someone has a huge phone bill. I wish I ___ so many phone calls last month! (not / make)
Someone else got the job. I wish he ___ me! (choose)

exercises.title: D · Correct the bold words
exercises.instruction: The words in bold in each sentence are wrong. Write the correct word or phrase.

items.prompt: I wish I **can** speak German, but I never learnt it at school.
I wish you **will** put your toys away! It's not difficult!
Do you sometimes wish you **can** fly?
I wish you **won't** lie to me all the time!
I wish the neighbours **won't** make so much noise.
If only she **will** ask me to go to the disco with her!
If only you **can** come with us!
I wish I ___ an MP3 player.
We all wish Tim ___ with the housework.
I wish I ___ to buy a lottery ticket last night.
I wish you ___ live so far away.
I wish they ___ keep changing the time of this programme.
Do you wish you ___ to help Michael in the shop last weekend?

exercises.title: F · 26th April 3500
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct word or phrase.

items.prompt: I wish today (1) ___ never happened!
If only I (2) ___ start the day again, I'd do everything differently.
Why did I forget to set the alarm last night? I really wish I (3) ___ done that!
I also wish I (4) ___ nearer the Earth. It takes such a long time to get there from Mars — especially when the traffic is bad.
(5) ___ I (6) a faster spaceship. Choose the first word.
If only I (6) ___ a faster spaceship.
Oh, I wish I (7) ___ that. Why am I so stupid?
I (8) ___ now that I'd never applied for the job in the first place.
I'm sure I won't get the job. I just (9) ___ tomorrow is better than today was.
